name: OSS_RMCS_DOC_T
description: This table stores RMCS source document data

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: CURR_CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate type used for the conversion of subscription value from the subscription transactional currency to the functional currency of the business unit.

columns.name: CURR_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Currency conversion rate used for the conversion of subscription value from the subscription transactional currency to the functional currency of the business unit.

columns.name: CURR_CONVERSION_RATE_DATE
columns.description: The date as of which the currency conversion rate is effective. This attribute is required only for fixed date currency conversions.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
